description: MLA attention over a paged KV pool, FlashMLA's API. Sparse: each token attends to the slots its indices name, in the pool and the optional extra one; sinks join the normalisation only. Dense: each request attends to its context rows; q's rope part is last, scores are q . row * sm_scale * kv_scale and values row[:head_dim_v] * kv_scale. With causal, query i of a request of length L reads its first L - query_length + i + 1 rows.

batch.description: Rows: one token each (sparse) or one request each (dense).

page_size.description: Slots per page of the KV pool.

n_extra_pages.description: Pages of the extra KV pool.

extra_page_size.description: Slots per page of the extra KV pool.

q.description: The queries of each row; dense: the rope part last.

kv_cache.description: The KV pool: packed dsv4 slots, or one 576-value row a page.

sparse_indices.description: Slots of the KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

sparse_lens.description: Leading sparse_indices each token reads; all when absent.

extra_kv_cache.description: The extra KV pool, packed dsv4 slots.

extra_sparse_indices.description: Slots of the extra KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

extra_sparse_lens.description: Leading extra_sparse_indices each token reads; all when absent.

sinks.description: Per-head logit added to the normalisation only, not to lse.

kv_scale.description: Multiplies every KV value, in the logits and the values.

output.description: Softmax-weighted sum of the read values; 0 for no row read.

lse.description: Log-sum-exp of the scaled logits, sinks excluded; for no row read +inf (sparse) or -inf (dense).

sources.content:
"""FlyDSL port of flash_mla_with_kvcache: DeepSeek-V4 sparse MLA decode.

The partial kernel gathers and dequantises packed dsv4 fp8 KV slots into one
bf16 LDS tile, 32 keys by 512 dims, in 16 blocks of 32 columns. The logits
GEMM reads a block directly. The value GEMM reads it with ds_read_b64_tr_b16,
whose 32-wide rows are the layout that instruction accepts. A flash softmax
runs over one group of keys for all 64 heads and writes one bf16 partial
output plus its log-sum-exp per group. The combine kernel merges the groups
of a row with its four waves splitting the groups, folds the sink logit into
the normalisation, and writes the bf16 output and the fp32 lse.

The launch grid stays one slot per 32 keys so its shape does not depend on
the live lengths. A segment whose live length selects k keys per CTA (KTIERS)
runs k/32 steps through the same tile in slot g and covers keys
[g*k, g*k+k). Later slots exit. The 128-wide SWA segment always keeps 32.
"""

import functools

import torch

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
from flydsl.expr import const_expr, range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import BFloat16, Float32, Int16, Int32, T
from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec

NHEAD = 64
DIM = 512
BI = 32
KPG = 32
# (live length cut, keys per CTA), cuts ascending: a segment wider than 128
# whose live length is strictly above a cut runs that many keys per CTA.
KTIERS = ((1024, 64),)
THREADS = 256
NWAVE = 4
HPW = 16
CWG = 64
MSLICE = THREADS // 64
CPT = DIM // 64
CUNR = 4
LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
LN2 = 0.6931471805599453
NEGBIG = -1.0e30
MINIT = -1.0e20


@fx.struct
class Shared:
    """LDS: 16 blocks of 32 keys by 32 dims, plus the softmax scratch."""

    vt: fx.Array[BFloat16, 16384, 16]
    bias: fx.Array[Float32, 32, 16]
    scr: fx.Array[Float32, 64, 16]


def _geom(ps):
    """(int32 words per page, int32 offset of the scale block, log2(ps))."""
    stride = ((ps * 584 + 575) // 576) * 576
    shift = 0
    while (1 << shift) < ps:
        shift += 1
    return stride // 4, ps * 144, shift


def _tiers(width):
    """The KTIERS a segment of this allocated width can reach."""
    if width <= 128:
        return ()
    return tuple(t for t in KTIERS if t[0] < width)


def _slots(width):
    """Partials a segment of this width can write: the most live CTAs any tier allows."""
    most, k = 0, KPG
    for cut, kt in _tiers(width) + ((width, None),):
        most = max(most, -(-min(cut, width) // k))
        k = kt
    return most


@functools.cache
def _workspace(batch, n1, n2, dev):
    """Partial output / lse scratch for one row count, within int32 element counts."""
    groups = _slots(n1) + _slots(n2)
    po = torch.empty((batch * groups * NHEAD * DIM,), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
    pl = torch.empty((batch * groups * NHEAD,), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
    return po, pl


@functools.cache
def _build(sm_scale, kv_scale, n1, ps1, n2, ps2):
    """Compile the partial and combine kernels for one definition."""
    has2 = n2 > 0
    g1 = n1 // KPG
    g2 = n2 // KPG
    ngrp = g1 + g2
    nslot = _slots(n1) + _slots(n2)
    tiers1 = _tiers(n1)
    tiers2 = _tiers(n2) if has2 else ()
    long_any = bool(tiers1 or tiers2)
    ksteps = tuple(sorted({KPG} | {t[1] for t in tiers1 + tiers2}))

    def _k_of(length, tiers):
        """Keys per CTA this live length selects."""
        k = fx.Int32(KPG)
        for cut, kt in tiers:
            k = (length > fx.Int32(cut)).select(fx.Int32(kt), k)
        return k

    def _na(length, tiers):
        """Live partials of one segment. Slots stay packed at the segment base."""
        n = (length + fx.Int32(KPG - 1)) // KPG
        for cut, kt in tiers:
            n = (length > fx.Int32(cut)).select((length + fx.Int32(kt - 1)) // kt, n)
        return n

    u1, sc1, sh1 = _geom(ps1)
    if has2:
        u2, sc2, sh2 = _geom(ps2)
    else:
        u2, sc2, sh2 = u1, sc1, sh1
    scale2 = float(sm_scale) * float(kv_scale) * LOG2E
    vscale = float(kv_scale)

    @flyc.kernel
    def part_kernel(q_t, kv1_t, ix1_t, ln1_t, kv2_t, ix2_t, ln2_t, po_t, pl_t):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx, by, bz = fx.block_idx
        row = fx.Int32(bx)
        grp = fx.Int32(by)

        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Shared).peek()
        vp = lds.vt.ptr
        vi = fx.recast_iter(Int32, vp)
        biasp = lds.bias.ptr
        scrp = lds.scr.ptr

        lane = tid % 64
        wave = tid // 64
        lr = lane % 16
        lg = lane // 16
        h0 = wave * 16

        len1 = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(ln1_t), row))
        if const_expr(has2):
            len2 = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(ln2_t), row))
            first = grp < fx.Int32(g1)
            plen = first.select(len1, len2)
            # Slot g owns [g*k, g*k+k). The grid keeps a slot per 32 keys, and
            # a slot whose g*k is past the live length exits.
            k = first.select(_k_of(len1, tiers1), _k_of(len2, tiers2))
            pos0 = first.select(grp, grp - fx.Int32(g1)) * k
        else:
            first = None
            plen = len1
            k = _k_of(len1, tiers1)
            pos0 = grp * k

        if pos0 < plen:
            qp = fx.get_iter(q_t)
            qbase = (row * NHEAD + h0 + lr) * DIM + 8 * lg
            qv = []
            for ks in range_constexpr(16):
                qv.append(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(qp, qbase + 32 * ks), T.bf16x8))

            kk = tid // 8
            jj = tid % 8

            def stage(kvt, ixt, nidx, shft, uwords, scoff, base_pos):
                kvp = fx.get_iter(kvt)
                spos = base_pos + kk
                if const_expr(long_any):
                    # A multi-step tail can start inside the buffer and end past it.
                    inb = spos < fx.Int32(nidx)
                    sidx = fx.ptr_load(
                        fx.add_offset(
                            fx.get_iter(ixt), row * nidx + inb.select(spos, fx.Int32(0))
                        )
                    )
                    okv = (sidx >= fx.Int32(0)) & (spos < plen) & inb
                else:
                    sidx = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(ixt), row * nidx + spos))
                    okv = (sidx >= fx.Int32(0)) & (spos < plen)
                slot = okv.select(sidx, fx.Int32(0))
                page = slot >> shft
                within = slot - (page << shft)
                pay = page * uwords + within * 144
                if jj == fx.Int32(0):
                    fx.ptr_store(
                        Vec.from_elements(
                            [okv.select(fx.Float32(0.0), fx.Float32(NEGBIG))], Float32
                        ),
                        fx.add_offset(biasp, kk),
                    )
                if jj < fx.Int32(7):
                    scw = fx.ptr_load(
                        fx.add_offset(
                            kvp, page * uwords + scoff + within * 2 + (jj >> 2)
                        )
                    )
                    scb = (scw >> ((jj & fx.Int32(3)) * 8)) & fx.Int32(255)
                    cmv = (scb + fx.Int32(249)) & fx.Int32(255)
                    c1 = cmv << 7
                    c2 = c1 | (c1 << 16)
                    nbase = pay + jj * 16
                    for c in range_constexpr(4):
                        v = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(kvp, nbase + c * 4), T.i32x4)
                        outs = []
                        for q4 in range_constexpr(4):
                            w = fx.Int32(v[q4])
                            x01 = (w & fx.Int32(255)) | ((w & fx.Int32(65280)) << 8)
                            x23 = ((w >> 16) & fx.Int32(255)) | (
                                (w >> 8) & fx.Int32(16711680)
                            )
                            o0 = (((x01 & fx.Int32(8323199)) << 4) + c2) | (
                                (x01 & fx.Int32(8388736)) << 8
                            )
                            o1 = (((x23 & fx.Int32(8323199)) << 4) + c2) | (
                                (x23 & fx.Int32(8388736)) << 8
                            )
                            outs.append(o0)
                            outs.append(o1)
                        base = (jj * 2 + (c // 2)) * 512 + kk * 16 + (c % 2) * 8
                        for s in range_constexpr(2):
                            fx.ptr_store(
                                Vec.from_elements(outs[s * 4 : s * 4 + 4], Int32),
                                fx.add_offset(vi, base + s * 4),
                            )
                else:
                    rbase = pay + 112
                    for c in range_constexpr(8):
                        vr = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(kvp, rbase + c * 4), T.i32x4)
                        dim = 448 + c * 8
                        fx.ptr_store(
                            vr,
                            fx.add_offset(vi, (dim // 32) * 512 + kk * 16 + (dim % 32) // 2),
                        )

            acc = []
            for n in range_constexpr(32):
                acc.append(Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32))
            mrun = fx.Float32(MINIT)
            srun = fx.Float32(0.0)
            zero4 = Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32)

            def step(bpos, acc, mrun, srun):
                # Copy before mutating. The untaken side of a later step's
                # branch reads the same list object, and in-place stores would
                # put this step's vectors into that side's yield.
                acc = list(acc)
                fx.barrier()
                if const_expr(has2):
                    if first:
                        stage(kv1_t, ix1_t, n1, sh1, u1, sc1, bpos)
                    else:
                        stage(kv2_t, ix2_t, n2, sh2, u2, sc2, bpos)
                else:
                    stage(kv1_t, ix1_t, n1, sh1, u1, sc1, bpos)
                fx.barrier()

                sv = []
                for t in range_constexpr(2):
                    sa = Vec.filled(4, 0.0, Float32)
                    for ks in range_constexpr(16):
                        av = fx.ptr_load(
                            fx.add_offset(
                                vp, ks * 1024 + (16 * t + lr) * 32 + 8 * lg
                            ),
                            T.bf16x8,
                        )
                        sa = Vec(
                            rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.f32x4, [av, qv[ks], sa])
                        )
                    bv4 = Vec(
                        fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(biasp, 16 * t + 4 * lg), T.f32x4)
                    )
                    for e in range_constexpr(4):
                        sv.append(fx.Float32(sa[e]) * scale2 + fx.Float32(bv4[e]))

                mblk = sv[0]
                for e in range_constexpr(1, 8):
                    mblk = mblk.maximumf(sv[e])
                mblk = mblk.maximumf(mblk.shuffle_xor(16, 64))
                mblk = mblk.maximumf(mblk.shuffle_xor(32, 64))
                mnew = mrun.maximumf(mblk)
                alpha = fmath.exp2(mrun - mnew)
                pv = []
                for e in range_constexpr(8):
                    pv.append(fmath.exp2(sv[e] - mnew))
                ssum = pv[0]
                for e in range_constexpr(1, 8):
                    ssum = ssum + pv[e]
                ssum = ssum + ssum.shuffle_xor(16, 64)
                ssum = ssum + ssum.shuffle_xor(32, 64)
                srun = srun * alpha + ssum
                mrun = mnew

                if lane < fx.Int32(16):
                    fx.ptr_store(
                        Vec.from_elements([alpha], Float32),
                        fx.add_offset(scrp, wave * 16 + lr),
                    )
                rocdl.s_waitcnt(lgkmcnt=0)
                a4 = Vec(
                    fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(scrp, wave * 16 + 4 * lg), T.f32x4)
                )
                for n in range_constexpr(32):
                    acc[n] = Vec(fx.fma(acc[n], a4, zero4))

                pf = []
                for t in range_constexpr(2):
                    pf.append(
                        Vec.from_elements(
                            [pv[4 * t + e] for e in range(4)], Float32
                        ).to(BFloat16).bitcast(Int16)
                    )
                tr_atom = fx.make_copy_atom(rocdl.cdna4.LDSReadTrans16_64b(), BFloat16)
                tr_layout = fx.make_layout(4, 1)
                for n in range_constexpr(32):
                    for t in range_constexpr(2):
                        base = (n // 2) * 1024 + (16 * t) * 32 + (n % 2) * 16
                        elem = base + (lane // 4) * 32 + (lane % 4) * 4
                        src = fx.make_view(fx.add_offset(vp, elem), tr_layout)
                        dst = fx.make_rmem_tensor(tr_layout, BFloat16)
                        fx.copy(tr_atom, src, dst)
                        bvv = Vec(dst.load()).bitcast(Int16)
                        acc[n] = Vec(
                            rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x16bf16_1k(
                                T.f32x4, [pf[t], bvv, acc[n]]
                            )
                        )
                return acc, mrun, srun

            acc, mrun, srun = step(pos0, acc, mrun, srun)
            for t in range_constexpr(1, len(ksteps)):
                if k > fx.Int32(ksteps[t - 1]):
                    for s in range_constexpr(ksteps[t - 1] // BI, ksteps[t] // BI):
                        acc, mrun, srun = step(pos0 + fx.Int32(s * BI), acc, mrun, srun)

            nonempty = srun > fx.Float32(0.0)
            inv = nonempty.select(fx.Float32(1.0) / srun, fx.Float32(0.0))
            lsev = nonempty.select(
                (mrun + fmath.log2(srun.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38)))) * LN2,
                fx.Float32(NEGBIG),
            )
            rowb = (row * nslot + grp) * NHEAD
            if lane < fx.Int32(16):
                fx.ptr_store(
                    Vec.from_elements([lsev], Float32),
                    fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(pl_t), rowb + h0 + lr),
                )
                fx.ptr_store(
                    Vec.from_elements([inv], Float32),
                    fx.add_offset(scrp, wave * 16 + lr),
                )
            rocdl.s_waitcnt(lgkmcnt=0)
            iv4 = Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(scrp, wave * 16 + 4 * lg), T.f32x4))
            pop = fx.get_iter(po_t)
            pbase = (rowb + h0 + 4 * lg) * DIM + lr
            for n in range_constexpr(32):
                vals = Vec.from_elements(
                    [fx.Float32(acc[n][e]) * fx.Float32(iv4[e]) for e in range(4)],
                    Float32,
                ).to(BFloat16)
                for e in range_constexpr(4):
                    fx.ptr_store(
                        Vec.from_elements([vals[e]], BFloat16),
                        fx.add_offset(pop, pbase + e * DIM + 16 * n),
                    )

    @flyc.kernel
    def comb_kernel(po_t, pl_t, sk_t, out_t, lse_t, ln1_t, ln2_t):
        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        bx, by, bz = fx.block_idx
        head = fx.Int32(bx)
        row = fx.Int32(by)
        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Shared).peek()
        krm = fx.recast_iter(Int32, lds.vt.ptr)
        scrp = lds.scr.ptr

        len1 = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(ln1_t), row))
        na1 = _na(len1, tiers1)
        if const_expr(has2):
            len2 = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(ln2_t), row))
            na2 = _na(len2, tiers2)
        else:
            na2 = fx.Int32(0)
        nat = na1 + na2

        msl = tid // 64
        mln = tid % 64
        dim = mln * CPT
        plp = fx.get_iter(pl_t)
        mpo = fx.get_iter(po_t)
        rbase = row * nslot * NHEAD
        negb = fx.Float32(NEGBIG)
        zerof = fx.Float32(0.0)

        def slot(i):
            """Address-safe group index for a possibly out of range trip."""
            ok = i < nat
            ii = ok.select(i, fx.Int32(0))
            gi = (ii < na1).select(ii, ii - na1 + fx.Int32(g1))
            return ok, rbase + gi * NHEAD + head

        # Each wave takes every MSLICE-th group: its own max, then its own
        # scaled sum; the waves are flash-merged through LDS below.
        mcur = negb
        for ib in range(0, nat, MSLICE * CUNR):
            for u in range_constexpr(CUNR):
                ok, off = slot(ib + msl + fx.Int32(MSLICE * u))
                lv = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(plp, off))
                mcur = mcur.maximumf(ok.select(lv, negb))

        ssum = zerof
        macc = Vec.filled(CPT, 0.0, Float32)
        for ib in range(0, nat, MSLICE * CUNR):
            for u in range_constexpr(CUNR):
                ok, off = slot(ib + msl + fx.Int32(MSLICE * u))
                lv = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(plp, off))
                sc = ok.select(fmath.exp2((lv - mcur) * LOG2E), zerof)
                ov = Vec(
                    fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(mpo, off * DIM + dim), T.bf16x8)
                ).to(Float32)
                macc = Vec(fx.fma(ov, Vec.from_elements([sc] * CPT, Float32), macc))
                ssum = ssum + sc

        if mln == fx.Int32(0):
            fx.ptr_store(
                Vec.from_elements([mcur], Float32), fx.add_offset(scrp, msl)
            )
            fx.ptr_store(
                Vec.from_elements([ssum], Float32),
                fx.add_offset(scrp, MSLICE + msl),
            )
        fx.ptr_store(macc.bitcast(Int32), fx.add_offset(krm, tid * CPT))
        fx.barrier()

        if msl == fx.Int32(0):
            mv = Vec(fx.ptr_load(scrp, T.f32x4))
            sv = Vec(fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(scrp, MSLICE), T.f32x4))
            mtop = fx.Float32(mv[0])
            for k in range_constexpr(1, MSLICE):
                mtop = mtop.maximumf(fx.Float32(mv[k]))
            tot = zerof
            acc8 = Vec.filled(CPT, 0.0, Float32)
            for k in range_constexpr(MSLICE):
                wk = fmath.exp2((fx.Float32(mv[k]) - mtop) * LOG2E)
                tot = tot + wk * fx.Float32(sv[k])
                part = Vec(
                    fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(krm, (k * 64 + mln) * CPT), T.vec(CPT, T.i32))
                ).bitcast(Float32)
                acc8 = Vec(fx.fma(part, Vec.from_elements([wk] * CPT, Float32), acc8))
            live = mtop > fx.Float32(-1.0e29)
            lsef = mtop + fmath.log2(tot.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38))) * LN2
            sink = fx.ptr_load(fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(sk_t), head))
            fac = fx.Float32(1.0) / (
                fx.Float32(1.0) + fmath.exp2((sink - lsef) * LOG2E)
            )
            mul = live.select(fac * vscale / tot.maximumf(fx.Float32(1.0e-38)), zerof)
            fx.ptr_store(
                Vec(fx.fma(acc8, Vec.from_elements([mul] * CPT, Float32),
                           Vec.filled(CPT, 0.0, Float32))).to(BFloat16),
                fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(out_t), (row * NHEAD + head) * DIM + dim),
            )
            if mln == fx.Int32(0):
                fx.ptr_store(
                    Vec.from_elements(
                        [live.select(lsef, fx.Float32(float("inf")))], Float32
                    ),
                    fx.add_offset(fx.get_iter(lse_t), row * NHEAD + head),
                )

    @flyc.jit
    def launch_all(
        q_t,
        kv1_t,
        ix1_t,
        ln1_t,
        kv2_t,
        ix2_t,
        ln2_t,
        po_t,
        pl_t,
        sk_t,
        out_t,
        lse_t,
        nb: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        part_kernel(q_t, kv1_t, ix1_t, ln1_t, kv2_t, ix2_t, ln2_t, po_t, pl_t).launch(
            grid=(nb, ngrp, 1), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )
        comb_kernel(po_t, pl_t, sk_t, out_t, lse_t, ln1_t, ln2_t).launch(
            grid=(CWG, nb, 1), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    def launch(q, kv_cache, sparse_indices, sparse_lens, extra_kv_cache,
               extra_sparse_indices, extra_sparse_lens, sinks, output, lse, ws):
        po, pl = ws
        launch_all(
            q.view(-1),
            _words(kv_cache),
            sparse_indices.view(-1),
            sparse_lens.view(-1),
            _words(extra_kv_cache),
            extra_sparse_indices.view(-1),
            extra_sparse_lens.view(-1),
            po,
            pl,
            sinks.view(-1),
            output.view(-1),
            lse.view(-1),
            q.shape[0],
            fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream()),
        )

    return launch


def _words(cache):
    """A flat int32 view of the whole storage a padded dsv4 pool lives in."""
    raw = cache.view(torch.uint8)
    total = raw.untyped_storage().size()
    flat = torch.as_strided(raw, ((total // 4) * 4,), (1,), 0)
    return flat.view(torch.int32)


def run(*, q, kv_cache, sparse_indices, sparse_lens, extra_kv_cache,
        extra_sparse_indices, extra_sparse_lens, block_table, cache_seqlens,
        cu_seqlens_k, causal, head_dim_v, sm_scale, sinks, kv_cache_format,
